claim.label: incumbent process
claim.sentence: CNC machine tending incumbent process An operator standing at the machine, opening the door, swapping the part and pressing cycle start, typically running two or three machines at once.

value.text: An operator standing at the machine, opening the door, swapping the part and pressing cycle start, typically running two or three machines at once.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: The manual method is well understood and its cost is directly observable, which is why the business case for tending is the easiest in robotics to write.
